finding.acceptance: Sealed goals are disjoint from training goals, and solutions verify exhaustively on the stated domain with a separate evaluator
finding.important_distinction: The existing vectorized evaluator already covers all 65536 pairs; this is an independent exhaustive-oracle coverage failure, not proof of an existing wrong accepted solution.
finding.mechanism: artifacts/NC-079/stack.py verified() checks all 65536 inputs using its own NumPy evaluate() implementation, then calls separate scalar reference_value() only for 1024 pseudo-random pairs. That second evaluator is not exhaustive. A wrong scalar result outside the sample passes undetected.
finding.required_fix: Run the independent scalar interpreter on all 65536 input pairs for EVERY accepted solution, or supply a separately implemented exhaustive evaluator with equivalent full-domain coverage. Add a negative control that injects a fault at (0,0) and requires fail-closed refusal. Keep vector evaluator independent of reference.

limits: No fresh full reproduction of solve rates or measured CPU; verdict is based on independently reproduced required verification-gate failure.
No independent exhaustive oracle was run on every accepted program, so no mathematical correctness certification of whole archive is asserted.
Previous review receipt remains untouched; no writes to champion, original candidate or upstream repository.
Local agent identity labels and Git hashes are not cryptographic identity proofs.
